title: Electric field horizontal coordinate
description: Essential: The student's final answer for part (1) must be expressed as a multiple of L, specifically (24/7)L.

title: E to B ratio
description: Essential: The student's final answer for part (2) must be expressed as a multiple of v0, specifically (5/8)v0.

title: Velocity component analysis
description: Important: The solution must correctly state that the horizontal velocity component is constant in the electric field, leading to v cos(53°) = v0 sin(53°).

title: Momentum change in E-field
description: Important: The solution must apply the impulse-momentum theorem vertically in the electric field, relating qEt to the change in vertical momentum (mv sin53° + mv0 cos53°).

title: Energy change in E-field
description: Important: The solution must apply the work-energy theorem in the electric field, relating qEL to the change in kinetic energy (1/2 mv^2 - 1/2 mv0^2).

title: Magnetic circular motion
description: Important: The solution must apply Newton's second law for circular motion in the magnetic field, stating Bqv = mv^2 / R.

title: Geometry of magnetic path
description: Important: The solution must correctly relate the radius R of the circular arc to the horizontal coordinate x1 using the geometry of the chord, yielding 2R sin(53°) = x1.

title: Sign error in momentum
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the impulse-momentum equation incorrectly handles the sign/direction of the initial vertical velocity component (v0 cos53°).

title: Incorrect velocity relation
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student incorrectly assumes the speed v is unchanged in the electric field or misidentifies the constant velocity component.
